name_zh: 李远哲/吴大猷/科学教育家：科学普及公民化与科教融合治理
name_en: Lee Yuan-tseh/Wu Ta-you/Science Educators: Science Popularization Citizenship & Science-Education Governance Fusion
description_zh: 李远哲 (1936-) 诺贝尔化学奖得主，返台任中研院院长 (1994-2006)，推动"高中科学人文同重"、"科学教育白皮书"、"科普教育法"立法，确立"全民科学素养"国策；吴大猷 (1907-2000) "中国导弹之父"、中研院物理所创所所长，早年倡导"科学救国"、创办《科学》月刊普及科学方法。两代科学家跨诺奖实验/导弹工程/科教治理，共同体现 M166 科学普及公民化——以"科学方法即公民素养、科教融合即治理现代化"双重逻辑，将精英科学转化为公共决策基础设施。
description_en: Lee Yuan-tseh (1936-) Nobel Chemistry laureate, returned as Academia Sinica President (1994-2006), pushed 'high school science-humanities equal weight', 'Science Education White Paper', 'Science Popularization Act' legislation, establishing 'universal scientific literacy' national policy; Wu Ta-you (1907-2000) 'Father of Chinese Missiles', founding director of Academia Sinica Physics Institute, early advocate 'science saves nation', founded 'Science' monthly for scientific method popularization. Two generations across Nobel experiment/missile engineering/science-education governance jointly exemplify M166 Science Popularization Citizenship—dual logic of 'scientific method = civic literacy, science-education fusion = governance modernization', converting elite science into public decision-making infrastructure.
reason_zh: 台湾科教治理独特在于"诺奖级科学家直接参与公共政策"：李远哲以科学权威推动课程改革/科普立法/研究治理透明化。M166 区隔于 M63 学科建置(学术)、M58 实验验证(方法论)，核心在于"科学方法下沉为公民基本素养、科教体制上升为国家治理基建"。
reason_en: Taiwan's science-education governance unique in 'Nobel-level scientists directly engaging public policy': Lee used scientific authority to drive curriculum reform/science popularization legislation/research governance transparency. M166 distinct from M63 Discipline Building (academic) and M58 Experimental Verification (methodology), core: 'scientific method sinks to civic basic literacy, science-education system rises to national governance infrastructure'.
steps_zh: 科学权威入世：诺奖/院士身份直接介入教育部/立法院/中研院治理，科学话语成政策话语
课程改革工程：高中"科学人文同重"、取消理工科死记硬背、引入探究式学习/跨域项目
科普立法与基建：《科普教育法》立法(2010)→全国科普馆网络/科学节/公民科学项目
研究治理透明化：中研院"卓越研究中心"竞争制/开放获取/伦理审查国际标准
科学外交与软实力：李远哲 ICSU/APEC/气候变化国际舞台，科学合作替代外交僵局
steps_en: Scientific authority entering world: Nobel/academician identity directly engages MOE/Legislature/Academia Sinica governance, scientific discourse becomes policy discourse
Curriculum reform engineering: high school 'science-humanities equal weight', eliminates STEM rote memorization, introduces inquiry-based learning/cross-domain projects
Science popularization legislation & infrastructure: Science Popularization Act (2010) -> national science museum network/science festivals/citizen science projects
Research governance transparency: Academia Sinica 'Excellence Centers' competition/open access/ethics review international standards
Science diplomacy & soft power: Lee at ICSU/APEC/climate international stages, scientific cooperation substitutes diplomatic deadlock
expected_zh: 以"科学方法即公民权利、科教体制即治理基建"双重逻辑，实现从精英科学到全民科学素养的跨越，科教投入产出比长期全球前列。
expected_en: Dual logic of 'scientific method = civic right, science-education system = governance infrastructure' achieves leap from elite science to universal scientific literacy, science-education ROI consistently global top tier.
case_zh: 台湾 PISA 科学素养长期全球前 5；中研院 Nature Index 全球前 20；《科普教育法》成亚洲首部专法；李远哲 2008-2011 担任 ICSU 首位华人主席。
case_en: Taiwan PISA scientific literacy consistently global top 5; Academia Sinica Nature Index global top 20; Science Popularization Act Asia's first special law; Lee Yuan-tseh 2008-2011 ICSU first Chinese president.
intellectual_tradition: Taiwan Science Education Governance / Scientific Literacy National Policy
cross_cultural_impact: East Asian science education reform reference; Nobel scientist in science policy model; science diplomacy for non-UN states
colonial_history: Japanese rule 1895-1945 (modern science education introduced); KMT rule 1949-1987
diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American scientists in US academia/industry; global research networks
indigenous_knowledge_system: Indigenous ecological knowledge integration in science curriculum (limited)
